title: Quantization Mosaic
blurb: A small network learned to paint one blue-and-white tile, and its 784 weights are a wall of tiles. Five copies stored in 32, 8, 4, 2 and 1 bits paint side by side: 8 bits changes almost nothing, 1 bit cracks the design. One kiln slider retrains the low-bit walls with their stamps in the loop until they paint it again.
